why: §24. The User-Agent is reserved by the provider and that is fine: SROS can set its own identity on its own side, and the two need not send the same string for the two observations to bear on one proposition. A fixed contract that is DOCUMENTED is reconstructable.

the_single_load_bearing_gap.evidence: the 124,793-byte specification contains zero occurrences of the word redirect
the_single_load_bearing_gap.implementation_observed: the probe dispatches through undici.Client.dispatch(), which does not follow redirects
the_single_load_bearing_gap.why_that_distinction_is_not_pedantry: a measurement contract must be frozen and reconstructable by a later reader. An undocumented default can change without notice, and if the counterpart began following redirects while SROS did not, both routes would still report a status and the divergence would be invisible in the data. Mission 1.70 killed the external pair on a redirect semantic that WAS documented; this one is not.
the_single_load_bearing_gap.and_it_is_the_case_the_brief_names: §25 lists 'undocumented redirects' among the behaviours where equivalence may not be assumed
